name: fitness_identity
title: Connected account
description: Read the connected account, permission grants and quotas. Start here; never ask for a password or token.

name: fitness_capabilities
title: Available actions
description: Read current connection/profile permissions and subscription eligibility. Commands list the account ceiling, not permission on a specific athlete. Collections describe schemas; check their permission against permissions. Target membership, coach control, consent, activation and revisions are rechecked at execution. Static command help is not authorization.

name: fitness_programs
title: Find programs
description: List one authorized page. Follow nextAfter even when the page is empty. Read only items relevant to the user request.

name: fitness_resources
title: Read records
description: Read a bounded page or exact record before modifying it. Preserve epoch/revision. Never crawl all collections. Use personal scope only for the connected owner; revoked access is unavailable. Prefer the permission-specific read tools for new calls.

name: fitness_catalog
title: Find exercises
description: Search exercise catalogue; prefer stable catalog keys to creating duplicates. Continue with nextAfter and version.

name: fitness_catalog_search
title: Search grouped catalogue variants
description: Read one bounded v2 catalogue page with existing French/English names and synonyms. Equipment is an exact legacy tag and muscle a broad legacy group. Text scores compare only this page, never anatomical evidence or equipment compatibility. Grouped by default; expandVariants separates matching variants. At most 48 evaluated variants per call. Follow nextCursor explicitly with identical filters, including after an empty page; each page consumes a normal request. No automatic traversal or mutations.

name: fitness_workout_vitals
title: Workout heart rate and active calories
description: Premium/Coach heart-rate summaries by minute and optional recorded active kcal for one session. Energy requires the athlete’s separate calorie collection choice; preserve its observed interval, which may be partial. Never infer calories per set or combine overlapping sources. Requires health:read, metrics:read and explicit athlete connector sharing; another athlete also requires Coach, current program access and their named coach consent. Missing minutes are unmeasured, not zero. Match actual timestamps to sets; never infer continuous effort, recovery or diagnosis. For a student, their own Premium or Coach entitlement is required; the coach’s paid plan does not upgrade the student.

name: fitness_muscle_insights
title: Muscle training insights
description: Premium/Coach muscle training evidence: weekly sets, explicit kg/lb normalized resistance volume, measurement coverage, durations and catalogue attribution. Incomplete load coverage is unavailable, never zero. Optional athleteId selects a currently shared athlete-owned program and requires Coach. Follow nextAfter with epoch/checkpoint and unchanged dates/athlete. Not measured growth, force or recovery; missing attribution stays unknown. For a student, their own Premium or Coach entitlement is required; the coach’s paid plan does not upgrade the student. Optional muscleEvidence distinguishes current catalogue groups, muscles and regions; it is not historical activation. Preserve unknown labels and never sum parent and child attribution as independent sets.

athleteId.description: Omit for your own records. Another athlete requires Coach and current access to their own program.

name: fitness_session_analysis
title: Analyze a training session
description: Read one recorded session, at most 50 observations per page. Continue with nextSetOffset and the same revision; totalRecordedRows is the paging inventory, not proof of physical set count. Only identity resolved certifies set/exercise totals and optional uncapped sessionXp (not account rewards). With identity unresolved retain raw observations, but totals, timing eligibility and sessionXp are null: never sum overlapping references, guess a mapping or infer progression. Latest duplicate corrections are marked corrected; unindexed observations remain separate. Read recordedLoad with recordedLoadUnit: only explicit kg/lb establishes a unit; weightKg is null otherwise. Missing values are unknown; explicit zero stays zero. Timers may include interruptions and are not continuous effort or wearable measurements. Access/context failures require a fresh authorized read, never cached advice.

name: fitness_push_results
title: Recorded Push bonus results
description: Read verified Push bonus results for one selected program and live session UUID. Requires metrics:read and current program access; another athlete requires Coach and current control of that athlete’s program. Read-only: compare actual with base/offeredTarget using explicit units and loadMilliunits / 1000. Set includeRewardDetails true to request awardedXp: exact settled cosmetic bonus after caps; absent/null means unknown, never a nominal or promised award. Incomplete or unconfirmed is unknown, not failure or zero. Corrections supersede earlier outcome IDs. No permission to attempt a bonus, award XP or change a future prescription. No history enumeration or automatic retry loop.

name: fitness_coach_push
title: Coach Push proposals
description: Read only your coach proposals for one exact athlete workout occurrence. Requires planning:read, current Coach subscription and control of that athlete program. No private health or other coach proposals. Use the returned athlete occurrence epoch/revision for coach.push.propose or coach.push.withdraw; never use a program checkpoint. The athlete alone confirms or declines. No polling.

name: fitness_push_adjustments
title: Later workout adjustments
description: Read retained future-workout adjustments linked to one exact current Push outcome from fitness_push_results. Requires metrics:read for the selected program; another athlete requires Coach and current control of that program. Each call checks one occurrence and at most 16 decisions. An empty entries page with nextCursor is not proof of no adjustments. Request additional pages explicitly only when useful; never scan the whole account or loop until a match. Keep the same scope, athlete, session and outcome with the returned cursor. On 409, reread the source result and restart explicitly; do not retry an obsolete cursor. Saved/withdrawn values, dates and goal are historical decisions, not confirmation of the effective prescription. Coverage is retained records only; missing legacy links remain unknown. No private health/readiness, attempt authorization, XP award or write access.

name: fitness_metrics
title: Training progress
description: Read bounded daily activity counts for one authorized program. Pass athleteId for individual progress; otherwise all visible participants are included. With measurementCoverage recorded, durationSeconds is null unless every session/run has a measured duration; distanceMeters is null unless every run has measured distance (also null when there are no runs). Compare durationMeasuredActivities with sessions+runs and distanceMeasuredRuns with runs. Explicit zero is measured; missing or legacy coverage is unknown, never zero or declining progress. Free includes four weeks; Premium up to 24 calendar months, checked for requester and athletes. A Coach subscription cannot extend Free student history.

name: fitness_command_help
title: Explain an edit
description: Read the allowed fields and value schemas before preparing an unfamiliar command. Missing access cannot be bypassed.

name: fitness_prepare_command
title: Prepare an edit
description: Prepare an immutable command without changing account data. Read the current epoch and revision first (null revision for creation). Keep the exact returned command for execution and retries. Confirm intended changes with the user.

name: fitness_execute_command
title: Apply the approved edit
description: Execute the exact command returned by prepare_command after user approval. This changes account data and may delete records. After timeout retry the SAME command; after conflict read the current record and ask before preparing a replacement. Permissions, subscription and quotas are checked on the server. Prefer the permission-specific edit tools for new calls; this generic entry point remains for existing clients.

name: fitness_edit_exercises
title: Apply approved exercises changes
description: Apply an exact immutable command returned by prepare_command for exercises, after user approval. Only the listed command kinds are accepted. Preserve operationId and all fields for retries. Existing account, resource, subscription and quota checks apply.

name: fitness_edit_health
title: Apply approved health changes
description: Apply an exact immutable command returned by prepare_command for health, after user approval. Only the listed command kinds are accepted. Preserve operationId and all fields for retries. Existing account, resource, subscription and quota checks apply.

name: fitness_edit_metrics
title: Apply approved metrics changes
description: Apply an exact immutable command returned by prepare_command for metrics, after user approval. Only the listed command kinds are accepted. Preserve operationId and all fields for retries. Existing account, resource, subscription and quota checks apply.

name: fitness_coach_metrics
title: Coach: apply approved metrics changes
description: Apply an approved metrics command to another athlete's authorized program. Requires an active Coach subscription, explicit coaching permission and current program membership. Prepare the exact command first; preserve it for retries. Never use this to widen access.

name: fitness_edit_planning
title: Apply approved planning changes
description: Apply an exact immutable command returned by prepare_command for planning, after user approval. Only the listed command kinds are accepted. Preserve operationId and all fields for retries. Existing account, resource, subscription and quota checks apply.

name: fitness_coach_planning
title: Coach: apply approved planning changes
description: Apply an approved planning command to another athlete's authorized program. Requires an active Coach subscription, explicit coaching permission and current program membership. Prepare the exact command first; preserve it for retries. Never use this to widen access.

name: fitness_edit_programs
title: Apply approved programs changes
description: Apply an exact immutable command returned by prepare_command for programs, after user approval. Only the listed command kinds are accepted. Preserve operationId and all fields for retries. Existing account, resource, subscription and quota checks apply.

name: fitness_coach_programs
title: Coach: apply approved programs changes
description: Apply an approved programs command to another athlete's authorized program. Requires an active Coach subscription, explicit coaching permission and current program membership. Prepare the exact command first; preserve it for retries. Never use this to widen access.

name: fitness_read_exercises
title: Read exercises records
description: Read one authorized page or exact record from the listed exercises collections. Preserve epoch/revision and follow nextAfter only when needed. This tool cannot change data. Existing resource access and quotas apply.

name: fitness_read_health
title: Read health records
description: Read one authorized page or exact record from the listed health collections. Preserve epoch/revision and follow nextAfter only when needed. This tool cannot change data. Existing resource access and quotas apply.

description: Read one authorized page or exact record from the listed metrics collections. Preserve epoch/revision and follow nextAfter only when needed. This tool cannot change data. Existing resource access and quotas apply.

description: Read one authorized page or exact record from the listed planning collections. Preserve epoch/revision and follow nextAfter only when needed. This tool cannot change data. Existing resource access and quotas apply.

name: fitness_read_programs

description: Read one authorized page or exact record from the listed programs collections. Preserve epoch/revision and follow nextAfter only when needed. This tool cannot change data. Existing resource access and quotas apply.

name: fitness_workflow
title: Product and workflow guides
description: Read product information and workflow instructions directly from GeniusFitness. For plans, Premium benefits, pricing, value or the 7-day trial, use topic subscriptions: it includes reference prices, benefits and eligibility caveats without an Internet search. Other topics explain permissions and operations. Does not read personal data, activate a trial or grant access.

name: fitness_workout_copy_preview
title: Compare a coach workout and student copy
description: Read one workout from the connected coach’s own catalogue and compare an optional student copy. Requires current Coach, planning rights, source program/exercise reads and target program/coaching writes. Review comparison.items: updatedFields change, retainedFields and conflictFields keep student values; explicit actions describe added, removed and locally deleted exercises. Legacy copies preserve ambiguous choices. Explain this review and obtain confirmation before workout.sync with the returned fingerprints and target epoch/revision. If comparison is missing, do not sync. Planning, history and health records stay unchanged. Never match source by name or auto-sync.

name: fitness_read_locations
title: Read your precise run routes
description: Read one bounded page or exact run route recorded by the connected account. Requires explicit location:read consent, never included by default. A coach grant cannot authorize another athlete’s GPS route. Ordinary run statistics contain no precise route. Respect revisions and cursor bounds.

name: fitness_edit_locations
title: Apply an approved route change
description: Update or clear only the connected account’s own run route after explicit location:write consent and user approval. Prepare run.route.update with the current revision. Send only polyline/routeSegments; preserve the immutable operation for retries. Coach access does not grant permission to edit an athlete’s GPS route.

name: fitness_coach_intents
title: Temporary instructions
description: Read bounded temporary instructions for one athlete program. Omit representationVersion for unchanged legacy v1; explicitly choose 2 to read every selected focus interest and nullable priority. Preserve the whole selection. Null priority is undeclared, never the first axis. On client-update-required, stop and update the client; never hide a focus, infer one objective or retry in another version automatically. Own Premium actions or a named Coach with current control; no health data. Read before changing, disclose replacements and preserve immutable commands. Cancel does not undo performed or skipped work. No polling.

representationVersion.description: Explicit complete focus representation. Omit for unchanged v1; never automatically downgrade.

name: fitness_coach_intent_target
title: Resolve exercise instruction
description: Resolve current/next exercise in an active session, or one exact exercise/set of a scheduled occurrence. Omit representationVersion for legacy v1; choose 2 explicitly before a structured focus command. V2 requires the full focusSelection and representationVersion:2 in command data; mono, skip, cancel and apply use focusSelection:null. Read command_help for the current selection policy. A nullable priority is not an inferred preference. Never guess IDs. Returns sourceVersion and athlete-intents epoch/revision for coach.intent.set. Incompatible overlapping adjustments replace the earlier instruction, including exercise/set overlap. Focus changes guidance only, never weight, repetitions, baseline or XP. A live skip must subsequently be applied explicitly with coach.intent.apply; scheduled skips are not completed work. Reread after conflicts; never silently replace.

representationVersion.description: Explicit complete focus representation. Omit for unchanged v1; never automatically downgrade.

name: fitness_catalog_reviewed
title: Read a reviewed partial catalogue page
description: Read at most 48 candidates from the pinned reviewed subset before filters. Group complete families unless expandVariants. Only known reviewed qualitative evidence contributes software relevance; unknown is not a match. Supplied inventory is a declaration, not a private profile read. Follow nextCursor explicitly with unchanged filters and limit. Every call uses normal quota. No full catalogue, physiological score, safety clearance, automatic traversal or mutation.

name: fitness_catalog_variant
title: Read one exact reviewed variant
description: Inspect an exact variant, its cited and opposing sources, required or optional apparatus and known limits. This partial corpus has no legacy fallback; unavailable media and unknown muscles remain explicit. No mutation.

name: fitness_session_skip_preview
title: Review passing or restoring one scheduled session
description: Preview skip or restore for one exact, already materialized future session. Read its scope, athlete, workout template and planning task first; retain one operation UUID. Does not change the routine, future recurrence, exercise sets, history or XP. Own planning requires planning:write; another athlete additionally requires coaching:write and current Coach control. A blocked preview cannot be confirmed. start_pending requires recovery of the original Start in the app; never invent a new ID to bypass it. Use fitness_session_skip_confirm with the exact returned review fields; do not use prepare_command.

name: fitness_session_skip_confirm
title: Pass or restore the reviewed scheduled session
description: Apply the user-requested skip or restore using the complete canonical confirmation from fitness_session_skip_preview: request, epoch, decisionRevision, expectedRevision, preparedAt and key as previewKey. No default fields or AgentCommand envelope. After a timeout retain the exact operation and body; never mint a new ID or change the target. Hosted MCP has no local journal. A replay returns the original historical receipt, even after a subsequent restore; read a fresh preview for current state. Rights, activation and normal request quotas are checked on every call. This reversible decision never completes work or awards XP.
